summary: Iteration 5: PA (Personal Accident) Insurance end-to-end validation. Backend: 82/82 pytest pass (71 regression + 11 new PA tests). POST /api/quotes/pa verified: class_1 / 1 person / age ~36 returns gross=$36.00, online_discount=$9.00, net=$27, SST 8% = $2.16, total=$29.16 (exact Tune Protect math). class_3 loading +35% verified: gross=$48.60, total=$39.37. num_persons=2 scales to $58.32. Age <18 or >70 returns 400 with 'ages 18 to 70' message. Missing required fields (full_name blank, beneficiary_name blank when enabled+required) return 400. form_config enforcement: PATCH product with beneficiary_name.enabled=false allows subsequent /quotes/pa with empty beneficiary_name to succeed (200). Auth gate (401 without token) + wrong-category product (404) verified. PA Easy product seeded with 6 specified benefits (Death $10K / Hospital $50/day / Ambulance $200 / Bereavement $1.5K / Dental $1K / Fuel Station $10K) and all 15 form_config keys. Frontend: /products/pa-easy marketing page perfect — hero 'Life is unpredictable / Your cover shouldn't be.', pricing card with $29.16 + strikethrough $36.00 + -25% badge + 6 benefits listed, 4 highlight tiles (pa-highlight-0..3), 6 benefit cards (pa-benefit-0..5), 'Why PA Easy' section, 7 FAQs, footer CTA; Buy Now navigates to /pa-quote/{productId}. /pa-quote Step 0: pa-persons-plus/minus/count work, price preview scales 1→2 persons ($29.16→$58.32). Step 1: all 26 expected data-testids present (pa-full-name, pa-id-type-nric/passport, pa-id-number, pa-gender-male/female, pa-dob, pa-nationality-malaysian/non_malaysian, pa-occupation-class_1..4, pa-email, pa-phone, pa-address, pa-postcode, pa-beneficiary-name, pa-relation-spouse/parent/child/sibling/other, pa-beneficiary-nric, pa-privacy-checkbox, pa-get-quote-btn). Get quote button correctly enabled only after all required fields + privacy consent. Step 2: insured summary (Jane Smith, Age 36, class_1), beneficiary card (John Smith / Spouse / NRIC 900202-10-5678), order summary (Gross $36.00 / -$9.00 / SST $2.16 / Total $29.16), pa-pay-btn present. Admin Products 'Edit · PA Easy' sheet renders all 15 PA toggle rows (enabled-{key} + required-{key} for every key); toggling enabled-beneficiary_nric OFF + save hides pa-beneficiary-nric on /pa-quote Step 1 while pa-beneficiary-name still renders — FORM_CONFIG RESTORED to all-enabled at end. Regression: all previously passing flows (Motor quote 835.65, Travel quote, claims auto-approve, admin Motor editor, login, role enforcement, vehicle lookup) still green per 71 regression tests. No bugs found.

PAQuote.jsx respects form_config via fieldOn/fieldReq helpers — conditionally skips fields when admin disables them (confirmed for beneficiary_nric). Get quote button disabled state logic correctly includes privacy consent AND all required+enabled fields.

Minor suggestion (not blocking): Landing/marketing footer could include a 'Personal Accident' link under Products column for discoverability.
